options.vftv.aspects.derive_modded.toolt: Give items without authored aspects values derived from their recipes, at each data load. Authored values win; {} suppresses. Off: no derived values. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.hollows.tooltip: Hollows rise from the Hush. Off: none rise. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.spread.tooltip: Flux turns ground into the Hush. Off: no spread; flux still pools. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.unattended.tooltip: Hush spread and Pealing Bells run with no player nearby. Default: false.
options.vftv.nodes.starter.tooltip: best_effort: place it near spawn if possible, else warn and tell the first operator to join. required: place it or crash at startup. off: never place it. Without one the world may be unwinnable until /vftv node starter <pos>. Read at server start. Default: best_effort.
options.vftv.research.mode.tooltip: gentle, standard or hard notes, or skip: buy research with aspect points instead. Open notes keep their difficulty. Default: standard.
options.vftv.vis_hud.x.tooltip: Left edge of the vis HUD, in GUI pixels. Range: 0 to 4096. Default: 4.
options.vftv.vis_hud.y.tooltip: Top edge of the vis HUD, in GUI pixels. Range: 0 to 4096. Default: 4.
options.vftv.warp.amplifier.tooltip: Warp strengthens Void workings and Void armour. Off: no amplification. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.gear.tooltip: Warp from worn and carried gear. Off: gear adds none. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.tax.tooltip: Warp raises vis costs and lowers infusion stability. Off: neither. Running infusions keep their plan. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.enabled.tooltip: Voice events at all. Off: no check rolls. Default: true.
